Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in Step 13 by incorrectly concluding that "Eleanor of Castile is Edward I's mother" based on a misinterpretation of the text retrieved from the Britannica page about Eleanor of Provence. The retrieved text explicitly stated that Eleanor of Provence was the "queen consort of King Henry III" and listed "son Edward I" in her notable family members. The Planner confused the relationship, likely misreading "son Edward I" (referring to Eleanor of Provence's son) as "Eleanor of Castile" (who was actually Edward I's wife, not his mother). This error propagated the wrong answer despite having access to the correct information in the previous step.
